faq.q: How do I order from Pamangan?
faq.a: Fill in the order form on our website and send it through Facebook Messenger, message our Pamangan Facebook page directly, or call or text 613-252-4037. We'll reply to confirm your order, the total and your pickup or delivery time.
Pickup is in Stittsville, Ottawa. When we confirm your order, we'll agree on your pickup time.
Yes, we deliver to selected areas near Stittsville and Kanata for a small fee based on your location.

faq.q: How far ahead should I order?
faq.a: We cook fresh in small batches on scheduled cook days, so please pre-order before the cut-off for the next cook day. Message us to check the next available date.

faq.q: Can I request a dish that isn't on the menu?
faq.a: Yes! Use the Request a dish form on our Menu page. The most-requested Kapampangan and Filipino dishes go on the menu first.
